question: Ali ............ that he had taken my mobile by mistake.
explanation: Verb of confessing; takes a that-clause with no object
source: Al-Moasser, Grammar in points, printed p.115 (PDF p.110), Q1
section: Grammar in points: Reported speech - Reported statements; Imperatives, suggestions and Advice

question: "I bought this tablet yesterday," Noura said. Noura said that she had bought ............ .
explanation: this -> that; yesterday -> the day before
source: Al-Moasser, Grammar in points, printed p.115 (PDF p.110), Q2
section: Grammar in points: Reported speech - Reported statements; Imperatives, suggestions and Advice

question: Mazen ............ me why he couldn't attend the meeting.
explanation: Reporting verb followed by an object (me) + wh-clause
source: Al-Moasser, Grammar in points, printed p.115 (PDF p.110), Q3
section: Grammar in points: Reported speech - Reported statements; Imperatives, suggestions and Advice

question: Yara ............ she would make a cake for my birthday party.
explanation: Past reporting verb, no object; will -> would in the reported clause
source: Al-Moasser, Grammar in points, printed p.115 (PDF p.110), Q4
section: Grammar in points: Reported speech - Reported statements; Imperatives, suggestions and Advice

question: "These books are mine," Ahmed said. Ahmed said that ............ books were ............ .
source: Al-Moasser, Grammar in points, printed p.115 (PDF p.110), Q5
section: Grammar in points: Reported speech - Reported statements; Imperatives, suggestions and Advice

question: Mr Gamal said that water ............ at 100°C.
source: Al-Moasser, Grammar in points, printed p.115 (PDF p.110), Q6
section: Grammar in points: Reported speech - Reported statements; Imperatives, suggestions and Advice

question: Yara said that she wished she ............ in Paris.
explanation: wish + past simple -> remains past simple
source: Al-Moasser, Grammar in points, printed p.115 (PDF p.110), Q8
section: Grammar in points: Reported speech - Reported statements; Imperatives, suggestions and Advice

question: Sama said, "I will do the shopping. I will clean the kitchen." Sama said that she would do the shopping ............ she would clean the kitchen.
explanation: Joining two reported statements: the second needs a linker with the same subject
source: Al-Moasser, Grammar in points, printed p.115 (PDF p.110), Q9
section: Grammar in points: Reported speech - Reported statements; Imperatives, suggestions and Advice

question: My mother warned me ............ out alone.
explanation: reporting verb + object + not to + infinitive
source: Al-Moasser, Grammar in points, printed p.115 (PDF p.110), Q10
section: Grammar in points: Reported speech - Reported statements; Imperatives, suggestions and Advice
